title: Fog Until Five
summary: A weather presenter reads the forecast on a night when fog is the only thing hiding the city. Then a slip arrives in her own handwriting.

beats.text: This is the Port Ellis weather. Tonight: heavy fog. Every light must be off.
Fog is good news. The infected hunt by sight, and tonight they cannot see.
Stay quiet. The fog holds until five, and I will tell you when it lifts.
My producer slides a slip under the studio door each hour. I read it out.
At three the handwriting is mine, and it is dated tomorrow.
It says: the fog will not lift at five. Do not open the door.
Listeners, ignore that. The fog clears at five. I promise.
My producer went home hours ago. I locked the studio myself.
It is five. Someone knocks, kindly, in my producer's rhythm.
The new slip says: fog until six. Whoever wrote it knew what I would do.
